As a Graphic Designer, you will be a visual storyteller for our marketing team, responsible for maintaining brand integrity through high-quality communication design and creative excellence.

You’ll help us protect honest people online by:

• Create engaging and visually compelling marketing materials across digital, print and spatial media, including but not limited to advertisements, social media materials, presentations, and event designs.
• Designing and developing a wide range of branded assets that strengthen and elevate our identity.
• Executing designs within established frameworks and generating fresh ideas, innovative concepts, and reusable templates.
• Collaborating with various teams to deliver high-quality design assets for both internal and external use.
• Maintaining, organizing, and continuously improving our design library and AI skills to ensure consistency and efficiency

You are the right future Veriffian for the job if you have:

• At least 3 years of experience in a similar role on similar tasks in an agency or in-house, creating various marketing materials, including digital channels and print.
• A strong portfolio with your exact role and scope clearly outlined for each project.
• Expertise in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (at least Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign).
• Strong understanding of design systems and layouts, with a keen eye for detail in both visuals and text.
• High proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
• Ability to collaborate with different teams, but also work independently.
• Adaptability to work in a fast-paced, evolving industry.
• Interest in AI’s applications in design.

What’s in it for you?

At Veriff, you’ll have the opportunity to:

• Help to shape the culture and voice of one of the fastest-growing tech companies in the region
• Contribute to the brand story of a company backed by top-tier investors and global entrepreneurs
• Do meaningful work with visible impact in a fast-scaling global organization
• Join a diverse team representing 60 nationalities
• Work in a pet-friendly, flexible environment where freedom comes with trust and responsibility
• Flexibility to work from home on an ad-hoc basis
• Take part in team events, learning opportunities, and all the perks of a disruptive tech scale-up

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.

When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career, while looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favorites include...

• Flexibility to work from home
• Stock options that ensure your share in our success
• Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
• Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
• Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
• Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!
